stories.title: Bitcoin gives back its overnight gain as Canada raises rates ahead of the Fed
stories.summary: Bitcoin rose to just above $81,000 overnight, then slipped back to about $80,500. The Bank of Canada raised its interest rate this morning, its first hike since July 2023. The Fed announces its decision at 2:00pm ET (01:00 Thursday Bangkok); a hold is expected, and traders are watching for hints of a hike in December.
points: The Bank of Canada raised its rate by a quarter point to 2.50%, and Governor Tiff Macklem said there could be a need to raise it further, per Investing.com.
The Fed's range is 3.75-4.00% after a quarter-point hike in September; ABC News puts the odds of a hold today at about 90%.
CoinDesk expects a 'hawkish hold': no change today but a warning that rates could still go up. It says three or more Fed officials voting for a hike would be a bearish signal.
Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference is typically at 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok), though Kiplinger notes that could change under Warsh.
Bitcoin fell about $1,000 from its overnight high to roughly $80,600 by 8:57am ET, per CoinDesk's live blog.

stories.title: Coinbase vendor leak: a reported 70,000+ users, a day before earnings
stories.summary: Coinbase says its analytics vendor Amplitude exposed a small subset of customer contact information. Coinbase says its own systems were not breached and funds are safe. A security firm's estimate of more than 70,000 affected users has not been confirmed by Coinbase. Coinbase and Strategy both report quarterly results after the US close on Thursday.
points: Coinbase said it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems and that customer funds are safe, per CoinDesk.
Security firm SlowMist says more than 70,000 users were affected; Coinbase has not confirmed that number, per FinanceFeeds.
Leaked emails and phone numbers are often used for fake 'support' calls and texts: an exchange will never ask for your password, seed phrase or 2FA code.
Coinbase reports after the close on Thursday 29 Oct; analysts expect a loss of about $0.23 a share on $1.21B revenue, per MarketBeat.
Strategy also reports after the close on 29 Oct, with a webinar at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company.

stories.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends on its preferred shares
stories.summary: At a special meeting on Wednesday, shareholders of Strategy, the bitcoin-holding company, approved changes that let four of its preferred share series pay dividends every day. Strategy uses these shares to raise money; this week it disclosed that it bought no bitcoin from 19 to 25 Oct and bought back some of these shares instead.
points: The changes cover STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD, per Strategy's SEC filing.
Preliminary results show the vote passed, per the filing; final counts were not given.
STRC moves to daily dividends from 1 Nov; the other three follow from 1 Jan 2027, per the filing.
Strategy made no bitcoin purchases from 19 to 25 Oct and repurchased $205M of STRC preferred shares, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs in, ether ETFs out
briefs.summary: On 27 Oct US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $176M, led by BlackRock's IBIT, while spot ether ETFs lost about $60.2M, per LiveBitcoinNews citing SoSoValue.

briefs.title: DTCC starts tokenizing securities
briefs.summary: DTCC, which runs US stock settlement, launched a service that creates blockchain copies of securities it holds, with 20 firms signed up including JPMorgan and Citi, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Moody's rates Ripple's stablecoin
briefs.summary: Moody's gave Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin investment-grade ratings (A2 and P-1), per The Block.

briefs.title: Ripple gets national trust bank approval
briefs.summary: Ripple received final approval from the OCC, the US national bank regulator, for a national trust bank on 26 Oct, per The Block.

briefs.title: Midterms could change crypto policy
briefs.summary: Prediction-market bettors on Kalshi give Democrats about a 64% chance of winning the Senate; a Democratic senator said the Clarity Act would 'absolutely not' be a priority under a Democratic Congress, per The Block.

briefs.title: Treasury's 'Plan B' for crypto rules
briefs.summary: With the Clarity Act stalled, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Treasury will work with the SEC and CFTC to fill the gap, without giving specific rules or a timeline, per Bloomingbit.

briefs.title: CFTC reported to be looking at Polymarket again
briefs.summary: Reuters, citing unnamed sources, reports the CFTC is investigating whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: Robinhood shares fall after results
briefs.summary: Robinhood stock was down about 6% before the open after its Q3 report, in which crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier, per CoinDesk.
